# Occupation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Occupation`](gmeow-Occupation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Occupation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A kind of work or profession, such as those classified by ESCO, SOC, or O*NET. Classifications are carried as open code values ([`gmeow:occupationClassification`](../properties/gmeow-occupationClassification.md)), never as OWL subclasses ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Occupation`](gmeow-Occupation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the shared what-one-does concept that both employment and expertise reference — a profession or kind of work classified by ESCO, SOC, or O*NET; it lives in core so sibling extensions can both reach it.

### Avoid when

- Avoid subclassing [`Occupation`](gmeow-Occupation.md) per profession (carry the classification as an open [`gmeow:occupationClassification`](../properties/gmeow-occupationClassification.md) code value, not a class — [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid conflating it with a [`gmeow:Role`](gmeow-Role.md) (a context-played position) or a [`gmeow:Post`](gmeow-Post.md) (an org-bound seat).

### How to use

- Mint a [`gmeow:Occupation`](gmeow-Occupation.md), carry its ESCO/SOC/O*NET classifications as open [`gmeow:occupationClassification`](../properties/gmeow-occupationClassification.md) code values, and relate it to a person through the employment or expertise layer rather than typing the person by it.

### Examples

- ex:softwareEngineer a [`gmeow:Occupation`](gmeow-Occupation.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "software engineer"@en.
